It features news analysis, talk shows, crime series, documentaries, and social discussions. Catering to all age groups, it offers diverse content and strong engagement, making it a trusted choice for advertisers and viewers worldwide.

It features live telecasts from Takhat Sri Harimandir Ji Patna Sahib, Gurdwara Sri Bangla Sahib, and special broadcasts from North America. Dedicated to Sikh teachings, history, Katha, Kirtan, and Dhadhi shows, it spreads the message of Gurbani worldwide.
